note: Synthetic OSINT corpus for the investigator evidence-gathering loop (Phase 65). FICTIONAL registry / adverse-media / sanctions records, keyed to the SYNTHETIC display identities the workbench lays over the (label-blind) aml-substrate population. NO real persons, companies, sanctions designations, or news. Every record is illustrative demo data. The agent loop may only surface findings whose verbatim quote grounds (locate_span) as a substring of one of THESE records' text — the gate proves a finding is anchored to this synthetic corpus, never that the finding is true. Designed to demonstrate: a chained discovery (a subject's corporate-registry link exposes an affiliated entity, which a sanctions screen then flags) that an investigator would not see in the transaction clutter; an honest empty result (a false-positive-trap subject returns no adverse findings); and the grounded-quote / illustrative-synthesis split.
